content:
Sam Nguyen: Hey team — finished the Okta setup but a few things are odd. When I sign in I can access Slack and GitHub SSO, but I don’t see the shared Drive folder or internal docs. Okta also popped up "Enrollment required: Windows Hello" — I’m on Mac and don’t have that. Also the 1Password invite landed in my personal gmail (sam.n.personal@gmail.com) instead of sam@redwood.com. Anyone seen this combo of issues?
IT Support: Welcome Sam! :wave: Can you confirm your laptop OS and whether you used the "Sign in with Google" button or the Okta SSO link? Also creating ticket IT-4521 so we can track.
IT Support: Ticket created: https://help.redwood.internal/tickets/IT-4521 — tagging Maria to handle provisioning + 1Password routing.
Sam Nguyen: macOS Ventura 13.6. I clicked the Okta SSO link from the welcome email. 1Password invite definitely shows my personal email as the recipient.
Maria (IT): Thanks @Sam. Two things likely happening: (1) group provisioning from Google Workspace -> Okta hasn't finished, which is why Drive folders aren't visible; (2) People Ops may have created the 1Password invite using an alternate contact email. We'll fix both.
Maria (IT): For the Okta enrollment on Mac, use Okta Verify on your phone or set up TOTP in the meantime. Steps:```1) Install Okta Verify (iOS/Android). 2) Sign into Okta on your phone with sam@redwood.com. 3) On desktop Okta, choose "Can't use Windows Hello?" -> "Set up an authenticator app" -> scan QR or paste secret.``` That avoids the Windows Hello prompt.
Maria (IT): For 1Password: Lisa can resend to your corporate address. If you ever see invites going to a personal address, please DM People Ops and we'll reissue to your work alias.
DevEx - Priya: For Drive access — group sync normally finishes within ~10–30 minutes after Okta provisioning. If it’s been >30m we can force a reprovision. I can kick the provisioning job, but I need your full username (sam.nguyen) — please confirm and I’ll run the sync: `/provisioning resync sam.nguyen` (admin action).
Sam Nguyen: username is sam.nguyen. Thanks Priya.
helpdesk-bot: [IT-4521] Status updated to "In Progress" by Maria (IT) — assigned to Maria (IT).
Lisa (People Ops): Hey Sam, welcome to Redwood! :tada: I just resent the 1Password invite to sam@redwood.com and removed the personal email from your profile. You should see it in a minute. LMK if not.
Sam Nguyen: Got the 1Password invite in my work email, thanks Lisa. Also was able to enroll Okta Verify and received a push. Still no Drive folder though.
DevEx - Priya: Kicked the resync at 1765432200. Expect groups to appear within ~5 minutes. If you still don't see it after 10, ping me and I’ll escalate to Google Workspace provisioning logs.
helpdesk-bot: [IT-4521] Note: provisioning resync requested by DevEx - Priya.
IT Support: Sam — can you confirm after 1765432300 whether Drive + docs are visible? If everything looks good we'll mark the ticket as resolved.
Sam Nguyen: Confirmed at 1765432350 — I can access the shared Drive and internal docs now. Enrollment + 1Password all good. Thanks everyone!
IT Support: Great — marking IT-4521 resolved. Reopen if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
